label: taunt
text: Nice try, Ben. I saw that bluff from across the room.

label: friendly raise
text: Raising to twelve. Come on, it's only chips.

text: That's a big bet. Please don't have the ace.

text: A river queen. Of course it was a queen.

text: Thirty six chips, thank you very much! That felt good.

text: Well, that's all my chips gone. It was a fun game, though.

text: I call. Let's see what the turn brings.

text: Fold. And I'm not happy about it.

text: Cy, you always say that when you're bluffing.

text: Wait, you had a flush the whole time?

text: My hands are shaking. Act natural. Act natural.
